title: CLDT Trail OSM Tags
description: Run-length-encoded OSM way tags along the CLDT, sampled every ~100 m and merged into contiguous runs of identical (surface, highway, sac_scale, mtb_scale). Consumed by the trail-style renderer to colour the polyline by surface or by SAC difficulty.

lastUpdated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the enrichment script last ran.

totalKm.description: Total CLDT length in kilometres at the time of enrichment. Used as a sanity check against the live GPX; if the live trail length differs by >5 percent the runtime loader treats this dataset as stale.

sampleStepM.description: Original sampling step in metres before run-length encoding. Informational; the runtime does not need to honour it.

runs.description: Sorted by fromKm. Adjacent runs do not overlap. Coverage gaps (where the script could not find an OSM way within the snap radius) are emitted as a run with surface=null, highway=null, sac_scale=null.

fromKm.description: Inclusive start of the run, in km from the SOBO start.

toKm.description: Inclusive end of the run, in km from the SOBO start.

surface.description: OSM surface=* value (e.g. asphalt, paved, unpaved, gravel, ground, dirt, grass, rock). Null when no nearby way had a surface tag.

highway.description: OSM highway=* value (e.g. path, track, footway, unclassified, tertiary). Null when no way found within snap radius.

sac_scale.description: OSM sac_scale=* value: T1 hiking through T6 difficult alpine hiking. Null when no SAC tag is set on the nearest way.

mtb_scale.description: OSM mtb:scale=* value (0-6). Informational; not currently rendered.
